journey.name: logging after wallet wipe
journey.description: Precondition: a disposable, unfunded regtest wallet without a PIN, with Dev Settings visible, on an English device. This deletes the wallet. Keep Bitkit running throughout the journey; its cached session log path must survive the wipe. This checks the iOS logger's recovery after regtest wallet reset removes the log directory.

actions.action: Open Settings, select Advanced (id "Tab-advanced"), open Dev Settings (id "DevSettings"), and tap Show Logs
Verify Log Files contains the current foreground session log and record its file name
Return to Settings and select Security (id "Tab-security")
Open Reset wallet (id "ResetAndRestore"), tap Reset Wallet, and confirm with Yes, Reset
Wait for Terms of Use, tap Continue, tap Skip Intro, and tap New Wallet (id "NewWallet")
Wait for Home; if offered security setup for the new wallet, tap Later
Open Settings, select Advanced (id "Tab-advanced"), open Dev Settings (id "DevSettings"), and tap Show Logs
Verify Log Files contains the session log with the same file name recorded before the wipe
Open that session log and verify it contains the new wallet's initialization messages, including Node started, rather than an empty file or Log file not found
